name: Fall of Dun Modr
summary: At Dun Modr, a northern fortress has fallen to a violent Dark Iron assault. In Menethil Harbor, a severely wounded survivor seeks an Alliance adventurer to go north and learn whether commander Longbraid the Grim or any of the garrison survived.

sections.title: A Northern Bulwark Broken
sections.body: For generations, Dun Modr has guarded northern Khaz Modan and the vital road and bridge across the Thandol Span, linking the Wetlands to the Arathi Highlands. After an ambush at the bridge, the garrison fell back to regroup inside the fortress. Before they could restore their defenses, overwhelming Dark Iron forces struck, slaughtering the defenders and driving them into a desperate flight.

sections.title: A Desperate Flight
sections.body: Harlo Barnaby, a young defender, was gravely wounded when a stray axe struck his back during the retreat. Believing him doomed, Longbraid the Grim and the remaining troops strapped Barnaby to their last surviving horse and sent him south to Menethil Harbor. He survived and awoke in the harbor tavern, burdened by survivor's guilt and entirely unaware whether any of his comrades had escaped alive.

sections.title: The Grim Remnant
sections.body: Longbraid the Grim still lives in the northern marshes near the captured fortress, holding a battered handful of survivors together. The veteran commander is relieved to learn that Harlo survived his grievous wound, but Dun Modr remains firmly in Dark Iron hands. Cutthroats and saboteurs occupy its halls and threaten the corridor between Khaz Modan and the human lands to the north.

faq.answer: Dark Iron dwarves overran and captured Dun Modr. The garrison had already been ambushed at the nearby Thandol Span, and the attackers struck before its defenders could secure the town, wiping out most of the regiment.

Harlo Barnaby is an Ironforge soldier who was stationed at Dun Modr and barely survived its fall. A thrown axe struck his back during the retreat, so his commander strapped him to the garrison's sole surviving horse and sent him south to Menethil Harbor for medical care.

faq.q: Where is Longbraid the Grim located?
faq.answer: Commander Longbraid the Grim took refuge in the wilderness just outside occupied Dun Modr, near the northern highway toward the Thandol Span.

faq.q: Why is Dun Modr strategically important?
faq.answer: Dun Modr is the Wetlands' northernmost settlement and fortification. It guards the southern approach to the Thandol Span, the only land bridge linking Khaz Modan with the Arathi Highlands and Lordaeron.

faq.q: Who are the attackers at Dun Modr?
faq.answer: The attackers are Dark Iron dwarves, members of the Dark Iron clan from the south who have pushed north into the Wetlands to destroy infrastructure such as the Thandol Span and harass Ironforge's territory.

what comes after fall of dun modr
faq.answer: After you confirm Longbraid is alive and bring him news that Barnaby survived, Longbraid enlists you in a grim mission of vengeance against the Dark Iron forces occupying Dun Modr's ruins.

angles.text: As a dwarf, the slaughter of Ironforge mountaineers and the desecration of Dun Modr by clan kin from the south is a bitter personal insult that demands blood in return.
As an Alliance member, you know Dun Modr's fall cuts safe overland travel between Ironforge and northern Alliance operations in the Arathi Highlands, leaving the corridor open to sabotage.
